content.title: PAYO Q3 Deep Dive: Upmarket Focus and B2B Expansion Amid Margin Consistency
content.summary: Cross-border payment platform Payoneer (NASDAQ:PAYO) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 9.1% year on year to $270.9 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $1.06 billion at the midpoint came in 0.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.06 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
